newsitem.title: BELGIUM: WEU offers help in Zaire crisis.
newsitem.headline: WEU offers help in Zaire crisis.

text.p: Western European Union (WEU) foreign and defence ministers said on Tuesday they were willing to provide air and logistics support in a humanitarian aid effort in Africa's troubled Great Lakes region.

At a meeting in the Belgian seaside town of Ostend ministers from the 10-nation defence grouping said the WEU would act if asked to do so formally by European Union ministers meeting next Monday in Brussels.

European External Affairs Commissioner Hans van den Broek told Dutch reporters there were 14,000 tonnes of food and medicine already in Uganda and Tanzania that the WEU could airlift to the regions where it was needed.
He also said the WEU was willing to give financial help to African nations that were helping in the Rwanda crisis.
WEU Secretary General Jose Cutileiro would attend a meeting in Stuttgart, germany later this week of countries contributing to the Canadian led mission to eastern Zaire, Van den Broek said.
